title: I’m building a fantasy extraction dungeon crawler with AI assistance. Does it look like something you’d play?
author: MidnightRavenGames
selftext:
Hey everyone! I'm developing Crypt Runner, a single-player fantasy extraction dungeon crawler, and I'd love some honest first impressions.

[Gameplay Trailer](https://reddit.com/link/1wa1vix/video/7uydfuqga5oh1/player)

The idea is to explore dangerous crypts, fight monsters, and gather loot. You decide when to get out. You can extract with what you've collected or risk going deeper for better rewards. Die, and you lose what you're carrying. Make it back, and bring your haul to camp to gear up for another run.

For the AI side of development, I create the game design and detailed plans first, then use AI to help implement those plans in code. The design decisions come from me, with AI acting as an implementation assistant. For example, I used AI to help fix a combat bug during playtesting by describing the problem clearly, and it was able to identify the issue and help resolve it without me having to dig through a long manual bug-tracing process. I also use it to build production tools, such as tools for laying out standard floors, walls, and corners, and for generally placing decor. It has been most useful as a way to speed up implementation and tool creation. I also use AI to generate some of the item sprites and NPC artwork to test if the style fits before going in and making the art myself.

I'm at the point where I'd really like to hear from people seeing the game for the first time. Based on the trailer and Steam page:

\- Does this look like something you'd be interested in playing? Why or why not?

\- What catches your interest, and what puts you off?

\- Is it clear what you'd actually be doing during a run?

I want to know whether the gameplay being shown makes you curious enough to try it.

Steam page and trailer:

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5073410/Crypt\_Runner/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5073410/Crypt_Runner/)

Please mention whether you normally enjoy dungeon crawlers or extraction games. It's completely fair if this isn't your kind of game; that context would help me understand the feedback.

Honest criticism is welcome. Knowing what doesn't appeal to you, or what the page isn't showing clearly, would be useful!
